hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: dataset_ref
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description:
phs num or similar Will delete all children of the dataset then itself
ex: DCC Harmonized data set

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# ============================= # Verbosity / logging controls # ============================= LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
# ============================= # Config (override via env) # ============================= api="${api:-http://172.20.0.2:8086/api}" retry_sleep="${retry_sleep:-15}" window_sec="${window_sec:-1800}" connect_timeout="${connect_timeout:-5}"
: "${dataset_ref:?dataset_ref is required}"
start_ts="$(date +%s)" deadline=$((start_ts + window_sec)) attempt=0
log "API : $api" log "dataset_ref : $dataset_ref" log "retry_sleep : ${retry_sleep}s" log "window_sec : ${window_sec}s" log "connect_timeout : ${connect_timeout}s" log "Starting retry loop"
while :; do attempt=$((attempt + 1)) now="$(date +%s)" remaining=$((deadline - now)) if [ "$remaining" -lt 0 ]; then remaining=0; fi
log "Attempt #$attempt (remaining window: ${remaining}s): DELETE /dataset"
# Limit only the connect phase; once connected, let it run (keep existing behavior) curl --show-error --fail \ --connect-timeout "$connect_timeout" \ --request DELETE \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${dataset_ref}" \ "${api}/dataset" rc=$?
if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then log "Dataset delete request accepted/completed" exit 0 fi
case "$rc" in 7) warn "Server not up yet (connection refused). Retrying...";; 28) warn "Connect attempt timed out. Retrying...";; 22) warn "HTTP error (>=400) due to --fail. Will retry...";; *) warn "curl failed with rc=$rc; retrying...";; esac
now="$(date +%s)" if [ "$now" -ge "$deadline" ]; then warn "Overall retry window reached; not failing the job because delete may still be running." exit 0 fi
sleep "$retry_sleep" done
